newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Wah Nam Group shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Wah Nam Group shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Wah Nam Group Ltd was suspended at the company's request on Friday pending an announcement, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said.
On Thursday, Wah Nam shares lost HK$0.003 to HK$0.143 on volume of 1.84 million shares.

Wah Nam Group is an investment holding company with subsidiaries that make consumer electronic and electrical products, plastic and electrical goods and ceramic tiles, as well as engage in property investment, and construction and administration of infrastructure projects.
